tool.name: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
tool.description: AWS services to run, govern and observe agents from any framework: Runtime, Gateway, Identity, Policy, Observability and Agent Registry.
strengths: Agent Registry auto-discovery across AWS Organizations
tool.pricing: Consumption-based per service, e.g. Runtime $0.1276 per vCPU-hour, Policy $0.000025 per authorization request, Gateway $0.005 per 1,000 invocations; Agent Registry includes a monthly free allowance (5,000 records).
tool.statusNote: GA since October 2025; Policy GA March 2026; AWS Agent Registry GA August 2026 (preview from April 2026).
tool.practitionerNote: Use it as the governance and runtime layer for agents on AWS; the registry and policy pieces are strongest when agents run on AgentCore Runtime/Gateway. Bedrock Agents (the managed agent builder) is tracked separately.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.

dataResidency.detail: Regional service (including AWS GovCloud US-West); Agent Registry supports customer-managed KMS keys. No multi-cloud or sovereign option.

deployment.detail: Fully managed AWS service; no self-hosted option.

auditLogging.detail: Control-plane API calls (e.g. Agent Registry, Gateway) are logged to AWS CloudTrail as management events.

soc2.detail: AgentCore is in scope for SOC 2 per AWS compliance validation.

iso42001.detail: ISO 42001 is not listed on the AgentCore compliance validation page.

euAiAct.detail: Infrastructure for building and governing agents, not itself an AI system placed on the market; obligations rest with the deployer.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary AWS service; framework-agnostic agents, but registry, policy and identity are AWS-bound.
